said: I have designed the sprite sheet for the Data-Mining Goblin, creating a character that is visually distinct with significantly larger ears, a slender profile, and a cool grey-green skin tone to prevent it from reading as an orc. This four-piece sequence includes a full-body view and three evolutionary head-and-shoulder stages, all rendered in the specified pixel-art style on a solid magenta backgr
prompt:
No shadows. Pixel-art sprite sheet in exactly the style and palette of the attached image. Crisp hard pixels on a strict grid, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, each sprite with a dark 1-pixel outline, drawn at its final size with no finer detail than that size can hold. One three-quarter top-down projection, never isometric. Sprites in a neat grid with even spacing on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background, nothing touching, no ground under them, no text unless asked. Bright yellow and bright red appear nowhere.

The Data-Mining Goblin of the attached sheet k1-classes redrawn so it never reads as an orc, even at 16 px: a goblin, much bigger and longer ears (clearly wider than its head), a smaller head, a thin body, NO tusks, a long pointed nose, bigger eyes, cool pale grey-green skin (no yellow); it still carries a pickaxe and glowing teal data crystals. Four pieces in one row, each alone on magenta: 1. full body, front-facing, the size of the figures of k1-classes; then its head and shoulders, the size of the heads of the attached sheet k3-stages, at three stages of growth: 2. a miner's lamp on its head; 3. a pickaxe on its shoulder; 4. a top hat and a monocle, its eyes glowing teal.

Drawn with exactly the same pixel size as the orcs of the attached sheet roles-2, each figure about as tall as one of them, the same dark outline.

No frames, no boxes, no grid lines, no borders between sprites; each sprite floats alone on the magenta.

No shadows, no smoke, no glow.

Keep exactly the colours of the attached frame F1: the grass as saturated and bright as in it (about #7cbd40), the paths warm sand (about #e4b469); warm honey wood, light cool stone, teal and plum cloth, cream bone.

No yellow, no orange and no red anywhere: those colours are reserved for the product's signals. The wood a muted honey brown, never orange.

Output the sheet as a PNG image.

Attached, in order: f1-town, roles-2, k1-classes, k3-stages. F1 is the approved frame: its style and colours rule.
issues: magenta cast on 12.6 % of the art
